name: Serendipity
source:
"If you had a moment in your life that would set you on a path to the hardest choice you'd ever have to make, would you still follow that path?"

Meet Natalya. She's what you'd call a jack of all trades. Stepping into class one day, even she didn't have the tools or fortitude necessary to comprehend just what would transpire in the next few hours. 

[From [url=https://bugstudios.itch.io/serendipity]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“如果你生命中的某个时刻会让你走上一条你必须做出的最艰难选择的道路，你还会走那条路吗？”

认识娜塔莉亚。她就是所谓的万事通。有一天，走进课堂时，即使她也没有必要的工具或毅力来理解接下来几个小时内将发生的事情。

[来自[url=https://bugstudios.itch.io/serendipity]Itch.io[/url]]
